variants.name: Trick or Treat
variants.note: Fortnitemares variant with a chance to spawn candy when you open containers

variants.name: Quack
variants.note: Unlocked from Sprite Mastery rewards, not found in matches. When it gains XP, every Sprite you carry gets extra XP

sprites.name: 8-Bit
sprites.ability: Puts an 8-Bit Shotgun in your first chest.

sprites.name: Adventure
sprites.ability: Upgrades a random item in your inventory each level.

sprites.name: Birthday
sprites.ability: Opening a chest can drop a Cake slice that heals Health and Shield. The chance grows each level, and at max level eliminations can drop Cake too.

sprites.name: Blinky
sprites.ability: Cloaks you for a short time after you take damage.

sprites.name: Bush
sprites.ability: Gives you a Bush after a while. At max level, a Bush on every elimination.

sprites.name: Crash Bandicoot
sprites.ability: Spin attack that damages nearby opponents.

sprites.name: Crown
sprites.ability: Extra Crown Wins after a Victory Royale. Only levels up by winning.

sprites.name: The Deer
sprites.ability: Increases your melee damage.

sprites.name: Dumpster Dive
sprites.ability: Food heals you more, and you get food when you leave a hiding spot. The food gets better each level.

sprites.name: Honey
sprites.ability: When your ranged shots hit, bees can pop out where they land.

sprites.name: Jackrabbit
sprites.ability: Adds another jump while you're in the air.

sprites.name: Jonesy
sprites.ability: Recovers some Health or Shield a moment after you're hit.

sprites.name: Killswitch
sprites.ability: Hangtime with better aim when you're in the air.

sprites.name: Klombo
sprites.ability: Random items at each level.

sprites.name: Mega Man
sprites.ability: Slip-and-slide movement.

sprites.name: Morgana
sprites.ability: Makes healing items work better.

sprites.name: One Wish Willow
sprites.ability: Eliminate an enemy to take the Sprites they had equipped. Getting hit pushes nearby enemies away, but taking it off shows you on the map.
sprites.where: Chests (exactly where isn't published yet; from the Obsession movie collab)

sprites.name: Onigiri
sprites.ability: Overdrive after you eat or drink.

sprites.name: Overshield
sprites.ability: An Overshield that gets stronger as it levels.

sprites.name: Pond
sprites.ability: Super Jump if you jump right after landing.

sprites.name: Shadow
sprites.ability: Reloads your other weapons while they're put away.

sprites.name: Sonic
sprites.ability: Gotta go fast: sprint faster.

sprites.name: Spooky Dash
sprites.ability: Jump in midair to dash, even through some objects. Charges refill faster each level.

sprites.name: Storm Scout
sprites.ability: Overdrive, and shows where the next Storm circles will be.
sprites.where: High areas, chests and Cheat Code consoles

sprites.name: Tails
sprites.ability: Hover with help from Tails.

sprites.name: Vampire
sprites.ability: Heals you as you damage enemies, more at higher levels.

sprites.name: X-Ray
sprites.ability: Marks enemies around you every so often.
